platform_compliance_principles.android_billing_requirement: Google Play Billing required for digital products on Google Play
platform_compliance_principles.apple_storekit: App Store Connect product catalog + StoreKit 2 client + App Store Server API for verification
platform_compliance_principles.google_play_billing: Google Play Console product catalog + Google Play Billing Library client + Google Play Developer API for verification

ios_high_level_flow: client request product catalog from server (design-only) and from StoreKit
user selects product, StoreKit initiates payment
on successful purchase, client obtains StoreKit JWS signed transaction
client POSTs JWS transaction to server (future endpoint: POST /api/iap/verify_apple)
server validates JWS via App Store Server API
server applies idempotency check on transaction id
server appends purchase ledger + wallet ledger entries
android_high_level_flow: client request product catalog from server (design-only) and from Google Play Billing
on success, client obtains purchase token
client POSTs purchase token to server (future endpoint: POST /api/iap/verify_google)
server validates purchase token via Google Play Developer API
server applies idempotency check on purchase token
server appends purchase ledger + wallet ledger entries
server acknowledges/consumes via Google Play Developer API

required_server_steps: validate signature/JWS or call Google Play Developer API
map verified product id to internal product family
required_error_modes: DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION -> idempotent return 200 with same delta

fraud_and_duplicate_prevention.replay_attack_protection: JWS signature + nonce + server-side timestamp window
fraud_and_duplicate_prevention.cross_account_abuse: verify Apple/Google account binding to internal user_id; reject mismatched account_id
fraud_and_duplicate_prevention.suspicious_burst_flag: design: > N verified purchases / 24h triggers manual review

compliance_checklist.item: Apple: use only StoreKit/IAP for digital content (no external payment links inside app)
Google Play: use Google Play Billing for digital content on Play distribution
Display real, complete pricing in local currency at point of purchase
Disclose gacha odds for any IAP that ultimately leads to randomized outcomes (loot box transparency)
Provide refund policy + restore purchases for non-consumables / subscriptions
Privacy/Terms required to be available pre-purchase
Children-targeted features and Kids category compliance (design: not children-targeted)
GDPR/CCPA wallet data export and deletion handle paid history retention obligations
